content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Design assets

This is a self-hosted commerce stack designed for digital creators in regions where payment processors block access. It combines free tools like GitHub Pages, Cloudflare Workers, and Supabase with a crypto payment gateway (NOWPayments). The result is a fully automated store: customers pay in crypto, the system verifies the transaction on-chain, and delivers your design assets instantly. You own the code, the data, and the process. No third party can shut you down, censor you, or change the rules. This architecture is pressure-tested in Zimbabwe, where currency collapse and financial isolation are the norm. It works where conventional platforms fail.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The frontend is hosted on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages—both free and globally fast. Backend logic runs on Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, which handle payment verification and file delivery. Orders are stored in Supabase (a free Postgres database) or Google Sheets. Files are stored in Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. NOWPayments handles crypto transactions with a 0.5% fee, no KYC, and automatic webhook integration. When a customer pays, the webhook triggers your backend to deliver the asset. The entire process is automated, secure, and requires no manual intervention. You deploy the stack once, and it runs indefinitely.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This is built for digital creators selling fonts, templates, presets, and other design assets in regions where Stripe, PayPal, and similar platforms are unavailable or unreliable. If you’re in Kenya, Nigeria, Zimbabwe, or similar markets, this stack gives you sovereignty over your commerce. It’s also for creators who refuse to rent infrastructure. Instead of paying monthly fees to platforms that may change their terms or shut down, you own the tools. This is not a temporary solution—it’s a permanent architecture designed to outlast payment processor restrictions and currency instability.
Own your commerce infrastructure—no platform can shut you down.
The Components That Make It Work Together

GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages host your storefront. Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script handle backend logic, including payment verification and file delivery. Supabase or Google Sheets store order data. Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 store your design assets. NOWPayments processes crypto payments with a 0.5% fee and fires a webhook the moment payment confirms on-chain. The webhook triggers your backend to deliver the asset. Each component is free or low-cost, and they integrate seamlessly. The result is a fully automated, sovereign commerce stack that requires no ongoing fees or third-party dependencies.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

Start with the Complete Builder Kit ($197) at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html. It includes all blueprints, templates, and documentation to deploy your stack in hours. Choose your hosting (GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages), backend (Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script), and storage (Supabase or Google Sheets). Integrate NOWPayments for crypto transactions. Load your design assets and test the workflow. Once deployed, your stack runs automatically. You own the code, the data, and the process. No platform can shut you down. No subscription required. This is infrastructure sovereignty—built for creators who refuse to be locked out.

To sell design assets with crypto payments, deploy a self-hosted commerce stack using GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, and NOWPayments for crypto transactions. Store order data in Supabase or Google Sheets and assets in Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. The stack automates payment verification and file delivery, requiring no manual intervention. You own the infrastructure, ensuring no platform can restrict your business. This architecture is designed for creators in regions where Stripe and PayPal are unavailable.
Automated delivery via Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script.

If you’re ready to deploy this architecture today, the Complete Builder Kit ($197) provides all blueprints, templates, and documentation. It includes step-by-step guides for integrating NOWPayments, configuring automated delivery, and scaling your stack. Visit https://coremerch.github.io/products.html to get started. This is not a tutorial—it’s a complete deployment kit for sovereign commerce infrastructure.
Your Deployment Checklist

1. Choose your hosting: GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Both are free and globally fast.
2. Select your backend: Cloudflare Workers for scalability or Google Apps Script for simplicity.
3. Set up order storage: Supabase for structured data or Google Sheets for lightweight tracking.
4. Store your design assets: Google Drive for ease or Cloudflare R2 for performance.
5. Integrate NOWPayments for crypto transactions. Use BSC, Solana, or TRON for low fees.
6. Configure the webhook to trigger automated delivery when payment confirms.
7. Test the entire workflow before going live.
8. Deploy your stack and start selling. No platform dependencies. No subscriptions.
Frequently Asked Questions
Can I use this stack if I’m not a developer?
Yes. The Complete Builder Kit includes templates and documentation designed for non-developers. You’ll need basic familiarity with web tools, but no coding experience is required.
What cryptocurrencies can customers use to pay?
NOWPayments supports 300+ cryptocurrencies. Recommended networks for low fees include BSC, Solana, and TRON, with transactions under $0.10.
Do I need to pay ongoing fees for this infrastructure?
No. The stack uses free tools like GitHub Pages, Cloudflare Workers, and Supabase. The only fee is NOWPayments’ 0.5% transaction charge.
Can I scale this stack as my business grows?
Yes. The architecture is designed for scalability. You can add more products, handle higher traffic, and integrate additional tools as needed.
What happens if NOWPayments goes down?
NOWPayments has 99.9% uptime. If it fails, the webhook won’t trigger, but your backend will retry. You retain full control to switch providers if necessary.
NOWPayments processes 300+ cryptocurrencies with a 0.5% fee.
